facts.what: 追问死神牌是否真指死亡、所爱之人的死
facts.anchor: ‘Does it ever actually mean death, though? Say…the death of a loved one?’

facts.what: 坦白来意是因为女朋友；她失踪那天他在上班、她衣物都在、早上还在睡
facts.anchor: she wasn’t there when I got home from work. All her clothes were

facts.what: 明知该担心失踪女性，却先庆幸对方成了「前女友」（ex-ists 双关）
说他报过警，警方称感情跑路常见、无能为力
facts.anchor: I went to the police and reported her missing

facts.what: 自称胃里有坏预感，问这算不算 intuition
facts.anchor: What would you call that? Intuition?

facts.what: 自认可以帮他找到平静、让他 move on
facts.anchor: I could help him find some peace so that he can move on, right?

facts.what: 脑内声音命令 Don’t do this，她仍决定 leap，认为这是她唯一幸福机会
facts.anchor: This is my one shot at happiness. It’s my time now, I know it.

facts.what: 她当面说出 She’s dead，并补充「你是对的，你女友走了」
facts.anchor: ‘I’m sorry, Finlay, but I’m afraid you’re right. Your girlfriend is gone.’

relations: Finlay 以失踪女友为由求助；Cassie 将其死亡当结论说出
